_comment: scribe-higgsfield plugin defaults (generated by packaging/build_plugin.py). This machine's own paths go in the per-user settings.json (scripts/settings.py: %LOCALAPPDATA%\scribe-higgsfield on Windows), which overrides this file key by key and survives plugin updates.
_python: interpreter for the child scripts; null = the Python running the script
_powershell: PowerShell for the GPU queue; null = pwsh (else powershell) on PATH
_chrome: chrome.exe: gate pages open in a new Chrome tab; null = the default browser
_gpu_queue: 5090-share gpu-share.ps1: GPU work (Qwen, upscale, TTS) waits for a lease; null = runs directly
_gpu_queue_log: the queue's log, named in lease failure messages

engines._qwen: local Qwen-Image-2.1 via ComfyUI: the fallback after ChatGPT's two tries, scene engine 'qwen', and 'chatgpt+insert'. false = ChatGPT only: validate/init/sync refuse those engines and a failed ChatGPT attempt stays failed

render._engine_registry: the /render skill's engines.json; resolves every driver not set in drivers
render._prompt_meta_dir: folder with prompt_meta.py, which stamps each image with its prompt

_realesrgan_dir: folder holding realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan.exe and models/ (download Real-ESRGAN ncnn Vulkan)
_html_questions: html_questions.py, which builds and reads the gate pages
_md_questions_legacy: md_questions.py; only to apply gate rounds built with md-questions; null = such a round is refused

narration._engine: who speaks the narration (narrate.py): 'recorded' = you read RUN/narration/reading.md into one file (needs only faster-whisper, asr.whisper_python); 'elevenlabs' = ElevenLabs TTS with tts.elevenlabs.voice_id (your cloned voice or a library voice; key in env ELEVENLABS_API_KEY); 'openai' = OpenAI TTS preset voice tts.openai.voice (key in env OPENAI_API_KEY); 'qwen-clone' = local Qwen3-TTS voice clone (tts.qwen_*; GPU); 'higgsfield' = Higgsfield generate_audio (higgsfield.voice_*) through the agent's MCP connection (narrate.py tts-plan / tts-ingest)

tts._comment: qwen_*/reference_* serve narration.engine 'qwen-clone' only; elevenlabs.* and openai.* their engines
tts._reference_wav: the voice to clone; null = the synth script's default reference
tts._reference_text: transcript of reference_wav; null = the synth script's default
tts._presence_eq: presence-eq.sh holding the PRESENCE_EQ ffmpeg filter for the narration track; null = no EQ, loudnorm only

elevenlabs._voice_id: ElevenLabs voice id: `narrate.py clone-voice --sample FILE` clones your voice (Instant Voice Cloning) and prints it, or copy one from elevenlabs.io > Voices; null = engine 'elevenlabs' refused
elevenlabs._model_id: ElevenLabs TTS model; null = the API's default
elevenlabs._output_format: mp3_*, wav_* or pcm_* (codec_samplerate[_bitrate]); 44.1 kHz pcm/wav need the Pro plan, mp3_44100_128 works on every plan
elevenlabs._base_url: API server; null = https://api.elevenlabs.io (EU data residency: https://api.eu.residency.elevenlabs.io)

openai._voice: a built-in voice: alloy ash ballad coral echo fable nova onyx sage shimmer verse marin cedar (tts-1*: fewer); OpenAI recommends marin or cedar
openai._instructions: speaking-style instructions, e.g. 'Calm, warm storyteller; unhurried.' (not for tts-1*); null = none

asr._whisper_python: python.exe of a venv with faster-whisper: the transcript check of every take, and cutting a recorded reading into sentences

_voice_profile: the voice profile the writer and the voice review follow, unless narration.json sets voice.profile
_runs_home: scribe-higgsfield: where the story file dialog of `scribe.py new` opens (each video's files go into its story's own folder); null = Videos/Scribeboard in the user's home folder
_pronunciations: optional JSON file of how to say specific words in every run ({"Nginx": "engine x"} or {"Nginx": {"say": "engine x", "heard": ["N jinx"]}}); a run's own RUN/pronunciations.json wins per word; null = none

images._engine: who draws scenes, title and character sheets: 'chatgpt' = the Codex CLI driver (render.drivers.chatgpt); 'higgsfield' = Higgsfield generate_image through the agent's MCP connection: the scripts prepare each job (render-prep / prep), the agent submits it, the scripts ingest the result (render-ingest / ingest)

higgsfield._comment: images.engine / narration.engine 'higgsfield' only. The picture model is not a setting: each run chooses it on its setup page from image-models/higgsfield.json (model id, params, price). Measured prices: nano_banana_2_1 4k 3 credits, gpt_image_2_5 4k high 4.25, seed_audio about 0.5 per sentence
higgsfield._voice_id: preset voice id from list_voices (voice_type preset); null = engine 'higgsfield' refused
higgsfield._max_credits: credit cap per run: no job is prepared when the run's quoted spend plus the next job's estimate would pass it (RUN/credits.json); null = no cap
higgsfield._image_credits: estimate per picture where no run setup exists (render-scribe tests); a setup run uses its image model's catalog price until it has its own quote
higgsfield._audio_credits: estimate per narration take until the run has its own quote
